request.subject: CITY:DINOSAUR:3

layers.text: Recolour only the orange-ochre hide of the awnings and the small tents: it becomes a dull sandy brown hide, colour #a67c3d with #6e4f26 shadows, not orange and not yellow; its dark brown spots stay. Add nothing: no rocks, no ground and no shadow. Do not redraw anything. Keep the orange feathers, the giant cream rib-cage, the horned skull, the dark huts, the standing stones, each shape and place, the size, black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
